remarks: Don't miss this stunning, newly updated 2 bedroom, 3 full, 1 half bath townhouse in Darien's desirable Pine Brook complex.This well-maintained unit is ideally located within walking distance to Darien's train station, downtown shops and restaurants. As you enter the lower level, abundant light fills the 2 story foyer. A Rec room/office with new FULL bath and laundry provide versatile living possibilities to suit any needs. An oversized one car attached garage provides nice storage. Enjoy the first floor's open floor plan, high ceilings, powder room, hardwood floors and working fireplace. Generous crown moulding and hardwood floors throughout give a sophisticated look to this living space. Easy access to the private patio out the living room is perfect for afternoon sun or quiet meal. Morning sun fills the updated eat-in kitchen while new appliances, quartz counter tops and new cabinets make this kitchen a dream to cook in. Upstairs you'll find a generous primary suite with vaulted ceilings and a luxurious, updated bath.The second bedroom upstairs also features a vaulted ceiling and updated full bath with soaking tub/shower. New pull-down attic stairs make the large attic space easily accessible. Both bedrooms feature high quality built-in closets. 2 Pine Brook is a wonderful opportunity to own an affordable condo in impeccable condition with all updated baths and new kitchen located in a very convenient part of Darien.
